Important Days

January

  • 1st: English New Year / Global Family Day.
  • 4th: World Braille Day.
  • 5th: National Birds Day.
  • 6th: World War Orphans Day.
  • 9th: Pravasi Bhartiya → Diwas Non-Resident Indian (NRI) Day.
  • 10th: World Hindi Diwas.
  • Hindi was first spoken at the UN General Assembly (UNGA) in 1949.
  • This date is also commemorated as "World Hindi Day".
  • 11th: Death Anniversary of Lal Bahadur Shashtri.
  • 12th: National Youth Day → On 12 January 1863, Swami Vivekananda was born.
  • 15th: Army Day.
  • Reasons for celebration of Army Day: To commemorate the appointment of Field Marshal K.M. Cariappa as the first Indian Commander-in-Chief of the Indian Army.
  • 16th: Startup Diwas.
  • 23rd: Netaji's Birthday (S.C. Bose) → This day is also celebrated as Parakaram Diwas.
  • 24th: National Girl Child Day.
  • 25th: National Voters Day.
  • 26th: International Customs Day.
  • 27th: International Holocaust Day; International Tourism Day.
  • 28th: Birth Anniversary of Lala Lajpat Rai; Data Protection Day.
  • 30th: Martyrs' Day (also known as Mahatma Gandhi's martyrdom day); World Leprosy Eradication Day.
  • 31st: International Zebra Day.

International Days are recognised by United Nations.

February

  • 1st: Indian Coast Guard Day.
  • 2nd: World Wetlands Day → On this day, Ramsar Convention was adopted in 1971 in Ramsar, Iran.
  • 4th: World Cancer Day.
  • 6th: International Day of Zero tolerance for Female Genital Mutilation.
  • 6th–12th Feb: International Development Week.
  • 8th: Safer Internet Day.
  • 10th: National Deworming Day; World Pulses Day.
  • 11th: World Day of the Sick; Int. Day of Women and Girls in Science.
  • 21st: International Mother Language Day.
  • 22nd: World Thinking Day.
  • 24th: Central Excise Day.
  • 27th: World NGO Day.
  • 28th: National Science Day.
  • 28 February 1928, Sir C. V. Raman and his student K. S. Krishnan discovered the Raman effect for which Raman received Nobel Prize in Physics in 1930 and Bharat Ratna in 1954.

March

  • 1st: Zero Discrimination Day.
  • 3rd: World Wildlife Day.
  • 4th: National Safety Day.
  • 8th: International Women's Day.
  • 2nd Wednesday of March: No Smoking Day.
  • 10th: CISF Raising Day.
  • 14th: Pi Day.
  • 15th: World Consumer's Right Day.
  • 16th: National Vaccination Day.
  • 20th: International Day of Happiness; World Sparrow Day.
  • 21st: International Day of Forests.
  • 22nd: World Water Day.
  • 23rd: World Meteorological Day.
  • 24th: World Tuberculosis (TB) Day.
  • The last Saturday of March: Earth's Hour Day → It is celebrated rom 8:30 pm to 9:30 pm local time, encouraging people to turn off non-essential lights for an hour to raise awareness about environmental issues.

April

  • 1st: Odisha Foundation Day; April Fool's Day.
  • 1st–7th: Prevention of Blindness Week.
  • 2nd: World Autism Awareness Day.
  • 5th: National Maritime Day.
  • 7th: World Health Day → On 1948, World Health Organization (WHO) was established.
  • 10th: World Homoeopathy Day.
  • 13th: Jallianwala Bagh Massacre Day.
  • 14th: B. R. Ambedkar Remembrance Day.
  • 17th: World Haemophilia Day. In haemophilia, blood does not clot due to deficiency of certain clotting factors.
  • 18th: World Heritage Day.
  • 21st: National Civil Services Day.
  • 22nd: World Earth Day.
  • 24th: National Panchayati Raj Day → 73rd CA 1992 constitutionalised Panchayati Raj system in India.
  • 25th: World Malaria Day.
  • 26th: World Intellectual Property Day.
  • 28th: World Day for Safety and Health at Work.

May

  • 1st: International Labour Day; Maharashtra Day; Gujarat Day.
  • World Laughter Day (First Sunday of May).
  • Saroa Dawa Sewan is a program that aims to eliminate lymphatic Filariasis by 2027.
  • National Filaria Control Programme (NFCP) was launched in 1955 to eliminate lymphatic Filariasis.

May (continued)

  • 3rd: Press Freedom Day.
  • 7th: World Athletics Day.
  • 1st Tuesday of May: World Asthama Day.
  • 8th: World Red Cross Day; World Thalassemia Day (Thalassemia occurs when body does not make enough hemoglobin).
  • 9th: Rabindranath Tagore Jayanti.
  • 11th: National Technology Day.
  • 12th: International Nurses Day → Florence Nightingale was the founder of modern nursing (lady with a lamp).
  • 16th: Buddha Jayanti or Buddha Purnima.
  • 17th: World Telecommunication Day, World Hypertension Day.
  • 18th: International Museum Day.
  • 21st: National Anti-Terrorism day/Tea Day.
  • 25th: Thyroid Day.
  • 31st: Anti-Tobacco Day.
  • Mother's Day (Second Sunday of May).

June

  • 1st: World Milk Day.
  • 2nd: International Sex Workers' Day.
  • 2nd: Telangana Formation Day.
  • 5th: World Environment Day.
  • 7th: World Food Safety Day.
  • 8th: World Oceans Day.
  • 12th: World Day Against Child Labour.
  • 14th: World Blood Donor Day.
  • 20th: World Refugee Day.
  • 21st: International Yoga Day.
  • 23rd: International Olympic Day.
  • 27th: Micro, Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (MSME) Day.
  • 29th: National Statistics Day → It is celebrated on the birth anniversary of P C Mahalanobis.

July

  • 1st: National Doctor's Day; National Postal Worker Day; Chartered Accountants Day.
  • 11th: World Population Day → On this day the world population reached 5 Billion.
  • 26th: Kargil Vijay Diwas.
  • 28th: World Hepatitis Day; Nature Conservation Day.
  • 29th: International Tiger Day.
  • The St. Petersburg Declaration on Tiger Conservation was made on 29th July 2010 which aimed to raise awareness about tigers and the efforts to protect them.

August

  • 6th: Hiroshima Day (On 1945, an atomic bomb named "Little Boy" was dropped on Hiroshima, Japan).
  • 7th: National Handloom Day; National Javelin Day.
  • 8th: Quit India Movement Day.
  • 9th: Nagasaki Day (On this day, an atomic bomb named "Fat Man" was dropped on Nagasaki, Japan); International Day of the World's Indigenous Peoples.
  • 12th: International Youth Day; World Elephant Day.
  • 13th: World Organ Donation Day.
  • 15th: National Mourning Day (Bangladesh); Independence Day in India.
  • 16th: Parsi New Year (Nowruz).
  • 19th: World Humanitarian Day.
  • 20th: World Mosquito Day; Sadbhavna Diwas.
  • 26th: Women's Equality Day.
  • 29th: National Sports Day → This day is observed as the birth anniversary of Major Dhayanchand.
  • Friendship Day (First Sunday of August).

September

  • 1st–7th: National Nutrition Week.
  • 5th: International Day of Charity; Teachers' Day (it is celebrated to honour the birth anniversary of Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan in India).
  • 8th: International Literacy Day.
  • 10th: World Suicide Prevention Day (WSPD).
  • 14th: World First Aid Day; Hindi Diwas → On 1949, Hindi was adopted as a official language of India.
  • 15th: Engineer's Day (India); International Day of Democracy.
  • 16th: World Ozone Day → On 1987, at Montreal, Canada, Ozone Convention was held.
  • 21st: International Day of Peace (UN); World Alzheimer's Day.
  • 22nd: Rose Day → It is celebrated for the welfare of Cancer patients.
  • 22nd: World Rhino Day.
  • 27th: World Tourism Day.
  • World Maritime Day → It is celebrated on the last Thursday of September every year.

October

  • 1st: International Day of the Older Persons.
  • 2nd: Gandhi Jayanti; International Day of Non-Violence.
  • 5th: World Teachers' Day.
  • 8th: Indian Air Force Day.
  • 9th: World Postal Day.
  • 10th: World Mental Health Day.
  • 11th: International Day of the Girl Child.
  • 13th: International Day for Disaster Risk Reduction.
  • 17th: International Day for the Eradication of Poverty.
  • 20th: World Statistics Day.
  • 24th: United Nations Day; World Development Information Day.
  • 31st: Rashtriya Ekta Diwas or National Unity Day → It is celebrated as the birth anniversary of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel (he was the first Home Minister of India).

November

  • 1st: Formation Day of 8 States (Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Haryana, Punjab, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh).
  • 6th: International Day for Preventing the Exploitation of the Environment in War and Armed Conflict.
  • 7th: Infant Protection Day; National Cancer Awareness Day.
  • 11th: National Education Day.
  • 14th: World Diabetes Day; Children's Day.
  • 19th: International Men's Day; World Toilet Day.
  • 25th: International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women.
  • 26th: Constitution Day of India → On 26th November 1949, our Indian Constitution was adopted.
  • 29th: International Day of Solidarity with Palestinian People.

December

  • 1st: World AIDS Day.
  • 2nd: National Pollution Control Day Computer Literacy Day; International Day for the Abolition of Slavery.
  • 3rd: International Day of Persons with Disabilities.
  • 4th: Indian Navy Day.
  • 5th: International Volunteer Day; World Soil Day.
  • 7th: Armed Forces Flag Day; International Civil Aviation Day.
  • 9th: International Anti-Corruption Day.
  • 10th: Human Rights Day.
  • 11th: International Mountain Day.
  • 14th: National Energy Conservation Day.
  • 16th: Vijay Diwas → This day is celebrated (16th December 1971) to commemorate India's victory over Pakistan in Indo-Pak War.
  • 18th: Minorities Rights Day in India; International Migrants Day.
  • 19th: Goa's Liberation Day (Operation Vijay carried out in 1961 that led to the liberation of Goa, Daman, and Diu from Portuguese rule); National Integration Day (it is celebrated to honour the birth anniversary of Indira Gandhi).
  • 20th: International Human Solidarity Day.
  • 22nd: National Mathematics Day (Ramanujan Day) → This day is celebrated as birth anniversary of Ramanujan.
  • 23rd: Kisan Diwas.
  • 24th: National Consumer Rights Day.
  • 25th: National Good Governance Day → It is observed as the birth anniversary of Atal Bihari Vajpayee (1924).
  • 26th: Veer Bal Diwas → It is celebrated to commemorate the extraordinary sacrifices made by the four sons of Guru Gobind Singh Ji.
  • 31st: New Year's Eve.

Key concepts

  • National Days – Republic Day (26 Jan), Independence Day (15 Aug), Gandhi Jayanti (2 Oct), Constitution Day (26 Nov)
  • International Days – World Environment Day (5 Jun), World Yoga Day (21 Jun), World AIDS Day (1 Dec), Human Rights Day (10 Dec)
  • Science/Tech Days – National Science Day (28 Feb, Raman Effect), National Technology Day (11 May), World Homoeopathy Day (10 Apr)
  • Civic Days – Army Day (15 Jan, K.M. Cariappa), Voters Day (25 Jan), Kargil Vijay Diwas (26 Jul), Vijay Diwas (16 Dec)
  • Birth Anniversaries – Vivekananda (12 Jan), Tagore (9 May), Major Dhyan Chand (29 Aug), Sardar Patel (31 Oct), Indira Gandhi (19 Nov), Atal Bihari Vajpayee (25 Dec)
  • Cultural/Heritage – World Heritage Day (18 Apr), International Museum Day (18 May), International Dance Day, Hindi Diwas (14 Sep, 10 Jan)
